normalization_plan.reason: 'to' is only consumed as the burn withdrawal recipient passed to _safeTransfer.
'from' is the allowance-checked source address of transferFrom.
'spender' is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
order sender is stored into the caller-supplied Context order struct.
order amount determines remainAmount and order.amount in addLimitOrder.
price32 is validated against mantissa bounds and expanded inside addLimitOrder.
the suggested id is resolved to a free id by _getUnusedOrderID.
prevKey only supplies single-linked-list navigation hints to removeOrder.
inputToken is validated against money/stock token to derive isBuy in addMarketOrder.
rmList is iterated and unpacked within removeOrders to call _removeOrder.
Context memory caches reserves, heads and the order manipulated across _addOrder and helpers.
liquidity is a temporary computed share amount minted in mint.
amountToTaker is computed, fee-reduced and transferred to the taker in _dealWithPoolAndCollectFee.
expanded RatPrice is consumed by orderbook dealing computations.
Order struct is loaded, mutated and deleted during order removal.
proxy data carries the graContract and token addresses used by _safeTransfer failover.
